data.name: You Will Rot
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to You Will Rot, an immersive open-world survival experience where realism meets intense multiplayer combat. In a massive, dynamic world shaped by real-world weather and time, you must scavenge for supplies, loot other players, and craft everything you need to survive. Whether you're a lone wolf or part of a clan, the world is unforgiving. The question is: how long can you last?

Set in the post-apocalyptic remains of Western Pennsylvania, this zombie survival game plunges you into a world overrun by the undead. A catastrophic event has wiped out most of humanity, leaving you to navigate the dangers of a crumbling society. With no power and limited resources, your only mission is survival. Roam through the eerie streets of Pittsburgh, searching for supplies, building shelters, and fending off the growing horde of zombies.

  • Realistic Open-World Sandbox
    Explore a vast, dynamic world shaped by real-world weather patterns, time cycles, and environmental hazards.

  • Put Yourself in the Game
    Use your phone and MetaHuman tools to create a character that mirrors your real-life appearance.

  • Massive Multiplayer
    Optimized servers support large player populations for epic PvP and co-op experiences.

  • Scavenge for Supplies
    Search abandoned buildings and hidden caches for food, water, weapons, and crafting materials using a spatial inventory system.

  • Intense PvP Combat
    Kill and loot other players in deadly firefights where your enemies are your richest source of loot.

  • Diverse Loot Locations
    Discover military bases, forest bunkers, and more—every area hides unique opportunities (and dangers).

  • Melee and Ranged Weapons
    Master knives, axes, bows, pistols, shotguns, rifles, and more. Hone your skills in close and long-range combat.

  • Realistic Ballistics
    Every shot counts. Ballistics are influenced by wind, material density, ricochets, and weapon characteristics for deep, tactical gunplay.

  • Extensive Weapon Customization
    Modify your guns with optics, grips, stocks, lasers, and barrels. Adjust handling, bullet velocity, recoil, and more—craft your playstyle!

  • Spray Paint Customization
    Personalize your gear and weapons with unique spray paint colors.

  • Health and Injury System
    Manage injuries, apply bandages, and craft medical kits. Injuries affect your abilities, making every encounter dangerous.

  • Persistent Progression
    Enjoy long-term progression with database storage that saves your progress.

  • Late-Game Civilization Building
    Survive, then rebuild! Assign roles, manage infrastructure, and run an economy as you attempt to create a new society.

  • Base Defense
    Craft defenses, reinforce doors and windows, and tame dogs to protect your loot from raiders—even when you’re offline.

  • Dynamic Rain & Wetness System
    Weather affects gameplay—cloth and paper get wet, metal and glass behave realistically.

  • Environmental Fire System
    Fire spreads through trees, buildings, and equipment—ignite, watch, and adapt.

  • Food and Water Management
    Keep your hunger and thirst in check by hunting, scavenging, or foraging—or face dire consequences.

  • Deep Crafting & Resource Collection
    Gather resources, chop trees, mine materials, and craft weapons, armor, and structures to survive.

  • Seasons & Realistic Weather
    Experience snowstorms, summer heat, and changing conditions that directly impact gameplay.

data.short_description: Survive a brutal open-world zombie apocalypse where you become the character! Scan your face, drop into multiplayer chaos, and fight to rebuild civilization. Scavenge, craft, loot, and defend—how long can you last in You Will Rot?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce or AMD Radeon
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
